title: Present perfect simple / continuous
recall: Present perfect simple va continuous farqi nima? 'for' va 'since' farqini ayt.
formula: Simple: natija hozir muhim, tajriba, nechta/necha marta — I have finished / I've been to London twice
Continuous: harakat davomiyligi, hali davom etyapti yoki yaqinda tugadi — I've been working for 3 hours
for + davomiylik (for 5 years), since + boshlanish nuqtasi (since 2020). State verbs — faqat simple: I've known him for years.

pairs.b: I've been writing the report all day.
I've been reading for two hours.
Someone has been drinking my tea!

en: I have already seen this film.
I have seen this film already.
I have already seen this movie.
I have seen this movie already.

items.uz: Men bugun uch piyola qahva ichdim.
en: I have drunk three cups of coffee today.

items.uz: Qancha vaqtdan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapsan?

items.uz: Men Alini ko'p yillardan beri ko'rmadim.

items.uz: Men bu kitobni ikki soatdan beri o'qiyapman.

items.uz: Bu hafta men Malika bilan uch marta gaplashdim.

speak: Hayotingdagi 5 ta tajriba haqida ayt: ever / never / already (present perfect).
Hozir nima bilan qancha vaqtdan beri shug'ullanasan? 5 ta gap: for / since (perfect continuous).
Bugun nimalarni qilib bo'lding va nimalar hali davom etyapti?
